column7: A panic in ConsumeMFARecoveryCode on /auth/mfa/stepup (also after the consume committed) reached the Recovery 500 with no mfa.error row and the code burned. verifyMFAStepUpCode now consumes through consumeRecoveryCodeRecovering, the helper the login path uses: "unavailable", uncounted, audited mfa.error. Landed with #3557; this row closes the step-up issue. The clearLoginFailures allow rows from the same review are gone: clearLoginFailures recovers its own panic (TestBestEffortCallSites_MutationKillsRecoverWrapper deletes that defer and requires the three MFA callers to be reported)
